The Stratosphere · Step-by-Step

Get into the Launchpad

You're in the Stratosphere. This walks you into the Launchpad, our community, one step at a time. Ten minutes and you'll know where everything is.

Your progress saves, so you can stop and pick it back up anytime.

Rather do it with a person? Come to the New Member Kickoff, Mondays at 12:30 PM ET: philstringer.com/kickoff
(1)
Step 1 of 12

Open the Launchpad on your computer

Your phone works too, but the first time is easier on a bigger screen.

🚀 launchpad.philstringer.com Open →
(2)
Step 2 of 12

No password yet? Set one

Open the page below, type the email you paid with, and click Reset my password.

🔑 Set my password Open →
Already have a password? Sign in and skip to step 4.
(3)
Step 3 of 12

Find the email and pick a password

Circle emails you a link within a minute. Click it, pick a password, and you're in.

Not in your inbox? Check spam and promotions. It's usually there.
(4)
Step 4 of 12

Add a photo and one line about you

Top-right corner, click your initials, then Edit profile. Add a photo and a one-line headline. That's what people see next to everything you post.

(5)
Step 5 of 12

Read Start Here

In the left menu, open Start Here. Read Welcome to the Launchpad and House rules. Two minutes.

1
The left menu. Start Here is the first room:
2
The two posts to read:
(6)
Step 6 of 12

Introduce yourself

Read Phil's intro in Start Here first. Then open Share Anything, click Start a post, and tell us three things: what you do, where you sell, and the one thing you want AI to fix first.

👋 Share Anything Open →
Our team replies to every intro. This is how the room learns your name.
(7)
Step 7 of 12

Spot your Crew number

Every Stratosphere member gets a Crew number, in the order they joined. It shows as a yellow badge next to your name, within the hour of joining.

Don't see it yet? Check back after the Monday call. It never goes away.
(8)
Step 8 of 12

The Monday call

Left menu, AI Rundown. Every Monday at 1 PM ET: what changed in AI this week, then Office Hours for your real stuff.

1
Open the next Monday's event:
2
The Zoom link is at the top. Same link every week. RSVP only sets a reminder:
📅 AI Rundown Open →
(9)
Step 9 of 12

Missed one? Watch the replay

AI Rundown Replays has every call, with timestamps so you can jump straight to what you need.

▶️ AI Rundown Replays Open →
(10)
Step 10 of 12

Pick your first workshop

Click Courses at the top. Every paid workshop is yours. Pick one, watch it, then do its Stringer Steps.

🎓 Courses Open →
(11)
Step 11 of 12

Post a win. Ask anything

Wins: post one by Friday, big or small. One becomes Win of the Week. Ask the Room: stuck on anything, ask there. Members help members.

🏆 Wins Open →❓ Ask the Room Open →
(12)
Step 12 of 12

Get the app on your phone

The Launchpad runs on Circle. Get the Circle Communities app and sign in with the same email. The Launchpad shows up inside.
